0022600214.text: The Utah Jazz (1-9, 1-4 at home, on an eight-game losing streak) host the Miami Heat (4-6, winners of their last game) in the Jazz's 11th game of the season. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain), and Keyonte George is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision, while Miami has no players listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with Utah winning the most recent meeting 115-111 in Miami on February 9, 2026.
